name: Kevin Stitt
stance: Says federal and state governments must jointly set AI guardrails; has also pushed rules on AI in political campaigns.

statements.text: I think this is an example of where we have to work together with the feds, the Congress, the states, in establishing a regulatory process that protects us from AI in the future.
At the NGA summer meeting said Oklahoma needs regulation of AI deepfakes in political campaigns and that he had considered a special session on it.
